plan.notes: Source: Allegany College of Maryland Credit Catalog 2026-2027, General Studies (Transfer) program path (https://catalog.allegany.edu/current/programs/general-studies.pdf). 'Successful completion of this program qualifies a student to apply for an Associate of Science degree in General Studies.' Caveats: (1) Footnote 1: 'Consult your advisor or Advising Center staff for appropriate courses' — applies to all Electives and English Elective. (2) Footnote 2: Social and Behavioral Science electives 'must be completed from two different Social and Behavioral Science disciplines.' (3) Footnote 3: 'Students transferring to many four-year colleges and universities will be required to complete two or more lab science to meet bachelor's degree requirements.' Hand-transcribed 2026-10-01.
